## Phase 1 RCA — Gerrit Verified latency

### Proven account

The 15–20m → 30–40m regression is not one new gate. It is the combination of:

1. **Mac test work grew sharply.** Representative macOS run 30723712651 at commit ceea743 (2026-08-01) ran the default tier in 677.41s (8,430 passed/79 skipped) and integration in 146.35s (91/7). Run 31631448140 at 7a1863f ran default in 1,453.10s (12,341/67) and integration in 241.38s (153/11): +870.72s, or +14m31s, inside pytest alone. Current git diff from ceea743 to main adds net ~91,205 test lines and collection grew by ~4.1k selected default tests.

2. **Several unit tests execute expensive mechanics repeatedly or wait on real production clocks.** Changeable artifacts and runtime proof:
   - tests/unit/test_live_jira_dc_provisioning.py:195 waits the full 120s missing-field budget. Focused A/B: 121.61s normally vs 0.71s with JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT=0; same AssertionError and Epic Link assertion.
   - src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/access_check.py:40-44 captures time.sleep at import. The test at tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py:263 patches time.sleep, but a full-suite pre-import leaves five real 5s sleeps. Focused pre-import: 25.62s; replacing the captured default: 0.64s with recorded [5,5,5,5,5].
   - scripts/dependency_audit.py:190-194 has the same captured-default defect. Direct A/B of the retry path: 15.007s real vs 0.000s injected while keeping three attempts.
   - tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_applier_stale_binding_404.py:236 exercises production 5xx backoff. CI: 15.78s; no-op backoff: 1.30s with the same propagation assertion.
   - tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py:467 is called independently by four guards at :487/:495/:515/:524. Profile: 4 calls, 32,124 ast.parse calls, 34,004 reads, 84.13s; process-local immutable cache: 1 call, 8,033 parses, 8,786 reads, 23.26s, identical results.
   - commit cf5155e528 added tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_corpus.py. Its lru_cache at :54 is process-local, so -n 3 fills it once per worker, not once per session. Runtime markers proved 3 fills under xdist and 1 serial. Two post-merge macOS jobs spent 321.6s and 495.6s aggregate call time in five corpus tests; the latter default tier took 33m51s. This worsens current/future CI but landed after the original 62-run mutation sample.
   - tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py:67 is the integration long pole: 90.18s on Aug 1 and 93.34–107.84s current, 37–45% of integration wall. The accepted left-changeful-mamba contract requires N=3000/6,000 events/24 commits/≥10x. A contaminated but internally comparable N sweep was 9.47s@256, 23.52s@512, 44.10s@1000, 176.02s@3000 with exact commit counts; it is load-sensitive approximately linear event persistence, not authority to shrink N.
   - tests/unit/test_snapshot_fetch_stall_abort_12e4.py:69 intentionally serves 15s; tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_acli_subprocess_timeout.py:172 spends ~9s in real timeout/reap windows. Their real socket/process coverage is legitimate, but production-scale test durations are not required.

3. **macOS/process contention amplifies the deterministic work, and org queueing adds the tail.** Across the 62 successful post-mutation-addition runs, macOS execution median was 27.0m, mean 26.95m, p90 30.68m; queue median 0.72m, mean 4.04m, p90 13.53m. Run 31631448140 queued 17.5m then executed 30.45m. A separate skipped-mutation run queued 27.57m then executed 27.8m. Prior ticket coercive-paediatric-bug proved the GitHub Free org limits (20 total jobs/5 macOS). The exact same post-wiki test set varied from a 20m07s default tier to 33m51s; wiki calls grew from 321.6 to 495.6 aggregate seconds. This is the subprocess/APFS workload becoming nonlinear under contention, not editor startup: targeted instrumentation found editor edit_workflow phases max 3.927ms and rejected the historical 35s setup attribution.

### Mutation hypothesis — rejected as the direct cause

Mutation landed at e0b3fdfc8e (2026-08-12 06:15Z). In 62 successful subsequent runs:
- wall median 32.52m, mean 36.22m, p75 39.62m, p90 51.52m;
- only 5/62 selected mutation shards; 57 skipped;
- active mutation used 250.7 runner-min total, mean 50.1 runner-min per active run;
- mutation was never the last prerequisite, so observed direct critical-path addition was 0m in all 62;
- selector-only cost was ~0.42 runner-min/run;
- active-mutation runs averaged 33.0m wall; skipped runs averaged 36.5m.

Mutation materially increases aggregate Ubuntu usage when selected and can aggravate org contention, but it cannot explain a regression present in 57 skip runs and it did not extend the measured critical path. Removing it would reduce aggregate usage in 8% of this sample, not recover the 14m31s pytest growth.

### Slow-tail comparison

Aug 1 top-25 default durations summed to 193.32 runner-seconds; current pre-wiki top-25 summed to 497.86s (+304.54s). Current CI named the 120s readiness test, four 21–25s AST guards, the 25s Jira retry, 15s retry/timeout tests, and repeated real builds. These outliers explain a material share, but not all, of the +775.69s default-tier growth; the residual is distributed across ~4.1k additional tests and contention-amplified git/subprocess/filesystem work.

### Tracker-checked remediations (coverage-neutral)

New and linked discovered_from this RCA:
- albinic-kyanite-goldeneye (P1): fake clock/zero logical budget for the 120s missing-field unit test; production default unchanged.
- coed-defectible-muskox (P1): late-bound/injected sleepers for Jira capability and dependency audit plus no-op backoff in stale-binding; preserve attempts and delay schedules.
- analogical-dashing-fennecfox (P2): compute immutable AST provenance once per process; preserve all four guards and defect-seeded detection.
- harmless-wavy-osprey (P1): remove per-xdist-worker/per-assertion wiki corpus recomputation while retaining all 178 real-pandoc bodies and every assertion.
- curricular-mean-cuckoo (P2): optimize import_tickets at N=3000; explicitly preserves left-changeful-mamba's accepted 6,000-event/24-commit contract.
- despotic-dorsal-greatdane (P3): reuse clean source/base artifact fixtures while preserving distinct real wheel/sdist boundary checks from ducal-statuelike-ladybird.
- classless-dainty-lamprey (P3): shrink test-only real socket/process timing windows while preserving the mechanisms accepted by suave-constant-cow and fizzy-trunk-salt.

Existing decisions:
- coercive-paediatric-bug rejects 3-way macOS sharding and -n3→4 because both raise runner-minutes/contention; not re-proposed.
- baseborn-subtle-cricket/crushable-choosable-llama accepted xdist and coverage retention; no coverage removal proposed.
- left-changeful-mamba fixes the import benchmark at N=3000; not reduced.
- repressive-delectable-swan introduced the wiki corpus; ashy-waterlog-hamadryas and dimmed-supersweet-xenarthra own production renderer hardening/spawn-cost decisions, not this xdist test-cache defect.
- nostalgic-crumby-tick owns mutation policy; evidence does not justify removal.
- existing --durations=25 observability (baseborn-subtle-cricket child 9ad9) was sufficient. No observability code change is needed.

### Disposition

Root cause confirmed. Remediation is decomposed into the seven linked tickets. The investigation made no code change and did not alter CI coverage, worker count, or runner topology.
